params.body:
Companion to gentells-site #228 and gentells-pipeline #377, which remove the unlisted Observatory plan: Intelligence opens the Observatory to read.

- "Give Observatory access" now moves the account to Intelligence. The button says so, and so does the notice after the click. Before, it moved the account to the Observatory plan.
- "Take it away (back to Explore)" goes. Every account that reads the Observatory now does so through its paid plan, and the row says "It comes with the {plan} plan". The plan selector above it stays the way to change a plan.
- The hint names only Intelligence. When the site does not send `observatory`, the fallback check is now `plan === 'intelligence'`.
- e2e: both Accounts tests use Intelligence. Full e2e suite 49/49, build passes.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
params.title: Accounts page: Observatory access comes with Intelligence
